sources.section: Build your own Front-end Framework / Library

summary.title: The chibivue Book
summary.one_liner: A step-by-step book that teaches you to build a small Vue.js-like framework (chibivue) in TypeScript, starting from a single "Hello, World" line.
takeaways: How Vue's reactivity system works, from basic principles up to EffectScope and CustomRef
How to implement a Virtual DOM, including patch rendering and a scheduler
How a template compiler handles data binding and directives
How single file components are built, including script setup, compiler macros and scoped CSS
summary.summary: The chibivue Book is a tutorial that walks through writing a Vue.js-style framework step by step, starting from a single 'Hello, World' line. The page lists four main parts: the Reactivity System, Virtual DOM, Template Compiler, and Single File Component support. Each part moves from basic implementation to more advanced features. The page text shown is brief, so details of the code and exercises are not included here.
